purpose: New hairstyle authoring references; not evidence of implemented models.

nova.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one isolated HAIR asset concept for a modular Zoomap videogame character. Attached image is a STYLE AND HEAD-PROPORTION REFERENCE, not the hairstyle to copy. Preserve its sharp intentional silhouette, broad hand-inked outlines, controlled cel shading, warm paper and simplified game-ready masses. A faint neutral grey head and ears with NO facial features is the fitting mannequin. Four large internally consistent orthographic views in a 2x2 sheet labeled FRONT, SIDE, BACK, TOP. Side is strict left-facing profile; top looks straight down. No body, clothes, accessories other than an essential hair tie, no extra alternatives, no loose photoreal strands, no wireframe. Modelable closed volumes with continuous rooted transitions. Each view must describe exactly the same shape and landmarks. NOVA: a sporty high ponytail with a parted sweep of brow-length curtain bangs. Warm copper hair. Hair smoothly gathers upward into a compact high tie at the back of the crown; the tail arches out, falls behind the neck and ends in two broad angular curled points. Tail length is about one head, staying above the shoulders of this enlarged-head stylized avatar. A few large directional hair panels, restrained engraved ink strokes, no noodle bundle. Bangs frame both eyes and have an asymmetric pointed end near each temple. Make the pony root visibly join the scalp and tail, with a plain small dark elastic band, not a floating tail.
